title: Cyberwave Simulation Backend Flag
description: A capability flag an asset or twin carries in `supported_simulation_backends`, and the one a policy names in `preferred_simulation_backend`: which simulators the robot is known to work in. A different vocabulary from common.simulation_engine.v1 on purpose: `playground` is a flag with no engine, and the engine `mujoco_warp` is the flag `mjwarp`. `isaac` is set by the asset author like `mujoco`; a compatibility attestation is optional evidence. ENGINE_TO_CAPABILITY_FLAG in the backend maps engines to flags.
